# Alpine aports MR

Needs a https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org account (not GitHub).

1. Register / sign in at https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org
2. Fork https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports
3. Branch `graft-0.2.2`
4. Copy [`APKBUILD`](APKBUILD) to `community/graft/APKBUILD`
5. Open an MR against `alpine/aports` `master`

`sha512sums` is already filled for the v0.2.2 GitHub tag archive.
